new.name: Skookum Falls
new.evidence: leaf coordinate already at the falls; Highway 410 near Greenwater

evidence: The single route is the Skookum Falls waterfall itself, on Hwy 410 near Greenwater (Mountain Project route 106709341; scenicwa.com viewpoint). The route name equals the real place name, which is the only place name that fits.

Ice's Stonelair is already a place-style name (a cliff/lair name), not a discipline bucket. No source found placing the routes elsewhere; the nearby Mont Chateau Trail sibling was not confirmed to hold them.

The Ice Pit is a real former quarry in De Pere near Green Bay with a north-facing ice wall (Mountain Project forum threads, e.g. https://www.mountainproject.com/forum/message/106632090); only the '(CLOSED)' tag is dropped.

Sources (https://www.mountainproject.com/area/106673043/cox-hollow) say only that the ice is at the west end of Cox Hollow, with no named sub-place; no sibling is an ice leaf. Kept rather than invent a name.

moves.evidence: Prospector Falls is on the south side of Death Canyon per Mountain Project (route 123462891) and tenthousandtoofar.com trip reports

evidence: Sentinel Ice Gully/Couloir is on the north side of the canyon near the Sentinel Turret/Albright Peak (tenthousandtoofar.com). Name mirrors the existing sibling 'South side of Death Canyon'; moderately sure, no source gives a finer place name.
